parties.petitioner: Rajesh Mitra @ Rajesh Kumar Mitra & Anr.

summary: Eviction suit based on 'admission' in unrelated case; Order XII Rule 6 CPC requires clear, unambiguous admission; mixed question of fact and law insufficient; 1997 Tenancy Act allows five-year post-death occupancy for specific heirs; tenant's mother's death in 2009 triggered time limit; admission of tenancy in mother's name not conclusive for eviction; judgment without trial improper; High Court erred in applying 'admission' without assessing context or legal implications; suit dismissal overturned due to premature decree.
legal_provisions_cited: West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1956 s.2(h)
West Bengal Tenancy Premises Act, 1997 s.2(g)
Code of Civil Procedure s.12 r.6
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment reversing trial court set aside; matter remanded with direction not to rely solely on purported admission without proper evidentiary assessment.
